snippet.title: Holy Shoot - Official Gameplay Trailer | The MIX Summer Showcase 2025
snippet.description: Take a look at gameplay, a boss fight, new enemies, and more in this latest Holy Shoot trailer for the upcoming FPS roguelite game. In Holy Shoot, the player embarks on a journey as a member of The Sanctum. The ultimate goal is to defeat the powerful demons that represent the Seven Deadly Sins. Each character, is granted unique abilities and traits that make them valuable assets in the fight against demonic forces. Holy Shoot will be available on PC (Steam), PlayStation, Xbox, and Nintendo Switch.
